what: Six leaf·branch images (three round-leaf branches·three small-leaf ones) are stacked into a 274:1352 bundle, and each image endlessly repeats skew (±1~2°) and rotation (−3~2°) on a different axis (bottom left·bottom right·bottom center·top right) in a 6~7s ease-in-out back-and-forth — the tempo is offset so the whole bundle sways in the wind. If an image is empty, eucalyptus-type leaves, yellow buds, and white flowers are drawn in SVG. The bundle can be rotated (180°) to hang from above, or mirrored with scaleX(−1)

options.[data-fx-part=sway]: Illustration sections (children) — data-key holds leaf-2, leaf-3, leaf-4, branch-1, branch-2, branch-3. If none exist, six sections are created and drawn. If a section already contains artwork (svg·img), that artwork is made to sway
options.--fx-dur · --fx-dur-b: (css variable) round-trip length, default 6s · first small leaf 7s
options.--fx-leaf · --fx-leaf-deep · --fx-bud ·: (css variables) two leaf colors, bud, petals, by default made from --kf-accent by rotating brightness and hue: two yellow-green tones and yellow · --kf-surface

from.where: shared.css .tw-treat (Hero · About panel · service strip · both sides of the Footer — original .treats leaves 1~4 · branches 1~3, keyframes b~g)
from.options: Default: the top right of the Hero is rotate(180deg), the service band is rotate(−90deg)
